86:- Registering a user also creates their `notification_prefs` row with `push_enabled` true, `quiet_start` `"22:00"`, `quiet_end` `"08:00"` and `nudge_time` `"20:00"`.
99:- `GET /v1/me` answers `{id, email, timezone, notification_prefs: {push_enabled, quiet_start, quiet_end, nudge_time}}`.
100:- `PUT /v1/me` takes any subset of `{timezone, push_enabled, quiet_start, quiet_end, nudge_time}` and answers 200 with the new `GET /v1/me` body; times are `"HH:MM"` 24-hour local times and an invalid value answers 422 `validation_failed` with nothing changed.
120:- `notification_prefs`: `user_id` (unique), `push_enabled`, `quiet_start`, `quiet_end`, `nudge_time` (all three `"HH:MM"`), `last_pass_date` (a date, nullable: the local date of the user's last daily pass).
240:- Delivery rule 5: if the user's local time is inside their quiet hours (from `quiet_start` inclusive to `quiet_end` exclusive, crossing midnight when `quiet_start` is later than `quiet_end`; no quiet hours when they are equal), the nudge becomes `suppressed` with reason `quiet_hours`.
